🇪🇬✨ One year in Egypt!

A whole year since I packed my bags and came to Egypt to pursue my Master’s degree. It honestly feels like yesterday.

This video takes me back to my first few weeks here, celebrating the festivals and proudly wearing traditional clothes from home 🇧🇼. Looking back, I’m just grateful for how far this journey has taken me.

One year down, and what a journey it has been! ❤️🇧🇼🇪🇬
comment: International study journeys often become as much about adapting to new cultural systems as academics. The ability to navigate differences is a skill that carries into every professional environment.
